blurb: Guests can enjoy guided brewery tours and tastings, participate in farming workshops and community events, and relax in indoor and outdoor seating areas. The farm features livestock and sustainable farming practices. The brewery produces a variety of craft beers using farm-grown ingredients.
extraNote: Tours and tastings must be booked in advance · Closed Easter Sunday, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Year's Day; closes at 3 p.m. on Christmas Eve
